
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /telegram  (/tg)                           │
  │  Telegram Notifications                     │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Configure Telegram bot for notifications and remote control.

  Usage:
    /telegram
    /telegram setup
    /telegram listen
    /telegram test
    /telegram send <msg>
    /telegram status

  Details:
    Connect RadSim to a Telegram bot for:
    
      • setup   — Configure bot token and chat ID
      • listen  — Toggle receiving messages from Telegram
      • test    — Send a test message
      • send    — Send a custom message
      • status  — Check current configuration

  Examples:
    $ /telegram setup
    $ /tg test
    $ /telegram send Task done!

  Related: /settings
